purpose: What pressing Play does. The launcher (RivalsDayZ.exe in @RivalsDayZ) converts content from the player's Rivals install, then starts DayZ in one of three modes.

rows.trigger: every Play, skipped when the Rivals build has not changed
rows.doc: Reads hero/ability text, portraits, icons and voice lines from the player's Rivals install into {game}/RivalsDayZ_Rivals and the DayZ Server folder. Never launches or changes Rivals. Failures leave the mod playable with built-in names.
Offline hunt in Chernogorsk; no server and no BattlEye.
Starts the host's own DayZ server, opens the port, logs 'Hosting at <public ip>:<port>', copies an invite code to the clipboard, then joins it.

_unverified.args: Server and -connect switches are standard DayZ ones but untested here; confirm on the PC.

rows.doc: Joins a friend's game from Melty's join link or a pasted invite code.

_unverified.args: Untested here; confirm on the PC with a second player.
